missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Безопасность' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Детей' is the genitive showing whose safety, and 'важна' is the short-form predicate. A common public-safety statement.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Безопасности' is the genitive form linked to 'вопрос'. 'Национальной' is the agreeing feminine genitive adjective. A standard institutional phrase.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Безопасность' is the accusative direct object of 'обеспечивает'; this soft-sign feminine noun looks the same as the nominative. 'Нашу' is the agreeing feminine accusative possessive.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Безопасности' is the prepositional form after 'о', the preposition governed by 'заботиться'. 'Сотрудников' is the genitive plural showing whose safety. A workplace pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Безопасности' is the dative form after the fixed expression 'уделять внимание чему-то'. The phrase means to pay attention to safety. A useful institutional collocation.

Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Безопасностью' is the instrumental form expressing what the city is known for. 'Своей' is the agreeing feminine instrumental possessive. A clean way to praise a place.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Безопасности' is the genitive form after 'без', stating a condition. 'Невозможно жить спокойно' completes the thought. A reflective generalization.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Безопасности' is the genitive form after 'ради', expressing purpose. 'Закройте дверь' is the imperative instruction. A practical everyday command.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Безопасности' is the prepositional form after 'о', the object of thought. 'Своей' is the agreeing feminine prepositional possessive. A natural reflexive frame.

Strategic focus: Accusative object with genitive plural. 'Безопасность' is the accusative object of 'повышают', and 'дорог' is the genitive plural of 'дорога' showing what is made safer. A road-safety statement.
